title.zh: 美SEC批准3倍杠杆比特币、以太坊等ETP
title.en: SEC Approves 3x Leveraged Bitcoin, Ether and Other ETPs

current_state.zh: The SEC approved 3x leveraged long ETPs referencing bitcoin, ether, gold, silver, crude oil and natural gas under the Securities Act of 1933, per Bloomberg ETF analyst Eric Balchunas.
current_state.en: The SEC approved 3x leveraged long ETPs referencing bitcoin, ether, gold, silver, crude oil and natural gas under the Securities Act of 1933, per Bloomberg ETF analyst Eric Balchunas.

updates.title_zh: Bloomberg Analyst: U.S. SEC Approves 3x Leveraged Bitcoin, Ether and Other ETPs
updates.title_en: Bloomberg Analyst: U.S. SEC Approves 3x Leveraged Bitcoin, Ether and Other ETPs
updates.what_changed_zh: The U.S. SEC approved Cboe BZX's proposed rule change to list and trade 3x leveraged ETPs tied to Bitcoin, Ether, gold, silver, crude oil and natural gas, a win for issuer Volatility Shares.
